ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 5 — Focused Visit (Follow-up) — Dwight D. Eisenhower

code.originalText: Seven-month coronary disease review after return to full-time work

text.paragraph: Mr. Eisenhower returns for his seven-month review. He works full time, travels most weeks, and plays golf twice a week, walking the course, without chest pain or breathlessness. The right-sided nosebleed four weeks ago has not recurred after cautery, and he stopped the petroleum jelly after two weeks. He continues every dose of aspirin and ticagrelor. His home blood pressure averages 120/74 and he has lost 1.5 kg since January. [S]
